import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final long MOD = 1000000007L;
    static final int maxN = 7;
    static final int max2N = 1 << maxN;
    static final int maxM = 100;
    static final int maxS = 64184;
    static final int maxSZ = 164184;
    static final int[] sizes = {0, 5, 11, 37, 137, 821, 7529, 164184};

    static int len;
    static long[] bfs = new long[maxS];
    static int SZ;
    static long[] what = new long[maxSZ];
    static int[] ind = new int[maxSZ];
    static int[][] next = new int[max2N][maxS];
    static int[] match = new int[maxS];
    static long[][] p = new long[maxN][maxM];
    static long[] prev = new long[maxS];
    static long[] cur = new long[maxS];

    static long powMod(long a, long b) {
        long res = 1;
        a %= MOD;
        while (b > 0) {
            if ((b & 1) == 1) res = (res * a) % MOD;
            a = (a * a) % MOD;
            b >>= 1;
        }
        return res;
    }

    static int bit(int n) {
        return 1 << n;
    }

    static long bitLong(int n) {
        return 1L << n;
    }

    static int hash(long state, int SZ) {
        int pos = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < 64; i++) {
            pos = (pos * 2 + (int)((state >> i) & 1)) % SZ;
        }
        for (int i = 64; i < 128; i++) {
            pos = (pos * 2) % SZ;
        }
        return pos;
    }

    static int getInd(long state) {
        int pos = hash(state, SZ);
        while (true) {
            if (what[pos] == state) {
                break;
            }
            if (what[pos] == 0) {
                what[pos] = state;
                bfs[len] = state;
                ind[pos] = len;
                ++len;
                return len - 1;
            }
            ++pos;
            if (pos == SZ) {
                pos = 0;
            }
        }
        return ind[pos];
    }

    static void precalc(int n) {
        int N = bit(n);
        long[] fixedSize = new long[maxN + 1];
        for (int mask = 0; mask < N; ++mask) {
            int cnt = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
                if ((mask & bit(i)) != 0) {
                    cnt++;
                }
            }
            fixedSize[cnt] |= bitLong(mask);
        }

        SZ = sizes[n];
        for (int k = 0; k < SZ; ++k) {
            what[k] = 0;
        }
        len = 0;

        getInd(1L);

        for (int k = 0; k < len; ++k) {
            long state = bfs[k];
            long[] predHall = new long[maxN];
            for (int mask = 0; mask < N; ++mask) {
                if ((state & bitLong(mask)) != 0) {
                    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
                        predHall[i] |= bitLong(mask | bit(i));
                    }
                }
            }

            for (int mask = 0; mask < N; ++mask) {
                long nxt = state;
                for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
                    if ((mask & bit(i)) != 0) {
                        nxt |= predHall[i];
                    }
                }
                next[mask][k] = getInd(nxt);
            }

            for (int i = n; i >= 0; --i) {
                if ((state & fixedSize[i]) != 0) {
                    match[k] = i;
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static long expectedMaximumMatching(int n, int m) {
        prev[0] = 1;
        for (int k = 1; k < len; ++k) {
            prev[k] = 0;
        }

        int N = bit(n);
        for (int j = 0; j < m; ++j) {
            for (int k = 0; k < len; ++k) {
                cur[k] = 0;
            }

            for (int mask = 0; mask < N; ++mask) {
                long prob = 1;
                for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
                    prob = (prob * ((mask & bit(i)) != 0 ? p[i][j] : MOD + 1 - p[i][j])) % MOD;
                }

                for (int k = 0; k < len; ++k) {
                    cur[next[mask][k]] = (cur[next[mask][k]] + prob * prev[k]) % MOD;
                }
            }

            for (int k = 0; k < len; ++k) {
                prev[k] = cur[k];
            }
        }

        long ans = 0;
        for (int k = 0; k < len; ++k) {
            if (match[k] == n) {
                ans = (ans + prev[k]) % MOD;
            }
        }
        return ans;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int m = n;
        precalc(n);

        long inv100 = powMod(100, MOD - 2);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < m; ++j) {
                p[i][j] = sc.nextLong();
                p[i][j] = (p[i][j] * inv100) % MOD;
            }
        }

        long ans = expectedMaximumMatching(n, m);
        System.out.println(ans);
        sc.close();
    }
}
